svg.title: Guest checkout with a Virtual Card Token and a DTVC
svg.desc: Sequence diagram: Guest checkout with a Virtual Card Token and a DTVC. 6 participants: Consumer, Agent platform, Mastercard network, Merchant, Acquirer or PSP, and Issuer. 7 steps, 7 crossing a trust boundary, 1 failure branch. Based on mastercard-agent-pay Agent Pay developer guides (unversioned, read 2026-10-11) (2026-10-11). Step 1: Consumer to Agent platform: User validation and consent. This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 2: Agent platform to Mastercard network: Request checkout for merchant domain. This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 3: Mastercard network to Agent platform: Return token, expiry and DTVC. This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 4: Agent platform to Merchant: Type values into card form. This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 5: Merchant to Acquirer or PSP: Submit authorization. This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 6: Acquirer or PSP to Mastercard network: Authorization with token. This step crosses a trust boundary. If DTVC wrong or already used: Validation fails and the issuer is told (outcome and response code not published). Step 7: Mastercard network to Issuer: Tell issuer DTVC result. This step crosses a trust boundary.
